items.title: Tyler Warren: Good yardage on one catch
items.description:
Warren brought in one of five targets for 22 yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Another forgettable performance in loss
items.description:
Jones completed 12 of 27 passes for 144 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed once for three yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday before being replaced by Anthony Richardson with 7:51 remaining.

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Keeps piling up TDs in win
items.description:
Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Minimal production with 15 touches
items.description:
Taylor rushed 11 times for 21 yards and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.

items.title: Nico Collins: Gets into end zone Thursday
items.description:
